# Arrival Time Requirements Quality Checklist: Show the Arrival Time for Each Route

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of PILOT-4590. They check that the arrival-time calculation rules and the display and recomputation rules are complete, clear, consistent and measurable before implementation and PR review.
**Created**: 2026-11-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (design context: [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md), [contracts/](../contracts/))

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the exact moment that counts as "the moment the routes were computed" defined (request start, routing response received, or routes displayed)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Key Entities] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK002 - Is it specified that all routes of one computation share a single departure time, as a requirement rather than only in the Key Entities description? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK003 - Are the recomputation triggers listed fully, including a delayed first computation that waits for the user's location and position updates? Or is "any other recomputation" deliberately left open? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK004 - Is it stated whether actions that do not recompute routes (selecting a route, pleasure scores finishing) may change the arrival text? [Completeness, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK005 - Is the full wording of the multi-day indication specified (singular/plural, spacing, parentheses), not only examples? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK006 - Is the position of the next-day indication relative to the duration, the distance and the pleasure indicator defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK007 - Is behavior defined for a missing, zero or invalid route duration from the routing service? [Completeness, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 - Is "rounded to the nearest minute" clear about what is rounded: the sum (now + duration), the duration alone, or the departure time (seconds truncated)? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases "Rounding"]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "consistent with the rounded duration shown" defined so that the displayed minutes plus the displayed clock always give the shown arrival time? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases "Rounding"]
- [x] CHK010 - Is "user's local time zone" defined as the device time zone at computation time, and is it stated what happens if the zone changes while routes are shown? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK011 - Is "later calendar day" defined using the local calendar date, not elapsed 24-hour periods? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK012 - Is the separator between duration and arrival text (", ") fixed by the requirement, or only illustrated by the example? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK013 - Is "immediately after that route's duration" clear when the duration is a multi-part value such as "1 h 20 min"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Edge Cases "Long routes"] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 - Do FR-002 ("rounded to the nearest minute") and the Rounding edge case (14:07 + "25 min" → 14:32, never 14:33) agree when the departure has a seconds part (e.g. 14:07:40)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 - Do the "very short routes" edge case (use the actual duration) and the Rounding edge case (stay consistent with the displayed duration) agree when "1 min" is shown for a 20-second route? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is SC-002 ("at most 1 minute" difference AND "exactly matches after rounding") internally consistent and aligned with FR-002? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK017 - Does the format "<duration>, arrive HH:MM" in FR-001 match the extended format with "(+N day[s])" from FR-004 and the edge cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK018 - Are the panel-only scope (Assumptions) and FR-007 (no other changes) consistent with the status summary line, which also shows the fastest duration? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-007] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the planner's rounding decision (research R1) traceable to and consistent with the spec wording, or does the spec need to be updated to match it? [Consistency, Traceability]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK020 - Can US1 scenario 2 ("a longer route never shows an earlier arrival") be verified objectively under the chosen rounding rule, including two durations that round to the same minute? [Measurability, Spec §US1] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK021 - Is SC-004 ("tell at a glance", "no mental arithmetic") measurable, or is it covered entirely by SC-001/SC-002? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK022 - Does SC-003 ("no stale arrival times remain") define how staleness is observed, e.g. a departure older than the latest computation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK023 - Do the acceptance scenarios give concrete expected strings for the walking, car and stops cases, as US1 scenario 1 does? [Measurability, Spec §US1 scenarios 3–5] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK024 - Are daylight-saving transitions (skipped or repeated local hour between departure and arrival) addressed in the requirements? [Edge Case, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK025 - Is a departure exactly on a minute or day boundary (e.g. 23:59:59 + 1 s) covered by the requirements? [Edge Case, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK026 - Is the behavior specified when a device clock change happens while routes are shown? [Edge Case, Spec §US2 scenario 3, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK027 - Are requirements defined for an earlier, slower request that finishes after a newer one (superseded computation), including which departure time wins? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases "Superseded computation"] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK028 - Is the waiting-for-location case (destination chosen before the position is known) covered in terms of which departure time applies? [Coverage, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK029 - Are routing error and no-route cases explicitly required to show no arrival text and to leave existing messages unchanged? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Non-Functional Requirements (Accessibility & Presentation)

- [x] CHK030 - Is it specified how the arrival time and the "(+N day)" indication must read in assistive technology, e.g. as part of the route button's accessible name? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK031 - Are layout requirements defined for the longer route text on a narrow panel (wrapping or truncation of "… , arrive 00:15 (+1 day)")? [Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK032 - Is it stated that the 24-hour format applies regardless of the browser/OS locale's 12-hour preference? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK033 - Is the assumption that the routing service's duration excludes waiting time at stops documented as a user-visible limitation (e.g. in README/help)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK034 - Is the reliance on the device clock and time zone being correct documented, with no fallback required? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Planner decisions that answer some items (rounding, departure capture, DST, next-day rule) are recorded in [research.md](../research.md) R1–R5; the spec text itself has not been updated.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
